lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: chords, radii, tangents, and the inscribed right angle
lessonRef.title: Guided practice A: chords, radii, tangents, and the inscribed right angle

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Use this example as the model for the guided set below.

items.prompt: An inscribed angle intercepts a 100° arc. Find it.

steps: Inscribed angle is half the arc.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A circle has radius 3. From an external point 5 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 8, because the tangent extends beyond the circle
4, because the tangent bisects the radius
4, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
2, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency

items.prompt: A circle has radius 5. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 90°, in terms of π.
A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 127°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 52°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
A circle has radius 5. From an external point 13 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 18, because the tangent extends beyond the circle
12, because the tangent bisects the radius
8, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
12, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A circle has radius 9. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 120°, in terms of π.
A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 94°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 106°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A circle has radius 3. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 180°, in terms of π.
